assertions.description: UDPSocket (the parent Direct Sockets surface that multicast extends) is a constructor in this context — true only inside an Isolated Web App, absent on normal pages by design.
The MulticastController interface object exists in this context ([Exposed=(Window, DedicatedWorker), SecureContext, IsolatedContext]).
MulticastController.prototype declares joinGroup, the method that accepts the MulticastGroupOptions dictionary carrying sourceAddress.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof MulticastController !== 'function') return false; return typeof MulticastController.prototype.joinGroup === 'function'; })()

assertions.description: MulticastController.prototype declares leaveGroup, which for an SSM membership must be called with the same sourceAddress used when joining.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof MulticastController !== 'function') return false; return typeof MulticastController.prototype.leaveGroup === 'function'; })()

assertions.description: MulticastController.prototype exposes joinedGroups as a readonly attribute (a getter and no setter), the FrozenArray that surfaces SSM memberships as MulticastMembership objects.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof MulticastController !== 'function') return false; const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(MulticastController.prototype, 'joinedGroups'); return !!d && typeof d.get === 'function' && d.set === undefined; })()

assertions.description: joinGroup declares exactly one required argument (groupAddress); the options dictionary with sourceAddress is optional with a default of {}.

On a secure but non-isolated page, UDPSocket must NOT be exposed — Direct Sockets is gated to Isolated Web Apps, so a secure context alone seeing no UDPSocket is conforming behavior. (This assertion passes on exactly the pages where the ones above fail.)
assertions.test: (() => { const isolated = window.crossOriginIsolated && location.protocol === 'isolated-app:'; if (isolated) return typeof UDPSocket === 'function'; return typeof UDPSocket === 'undefined'; })()

assertions.description: joinGroup('232.1.1.1', { sourceAddress: '192.0.2.100' }) creates a source-specific membership that resolves with undefined and filters inbound datagrams to the named source; validation rejects family mismatches and non-unicast sources with TypeError.
assertions.test: Requires an installed Isolated Web App with the direct-sockets and direct-sockets-multicast permissions policies, launched with --enable-blink-features=SourceSpecificMulticastInDirectSockets (flag status 'test': the generic experimental-features flag does not enable it), plus a multicast-capable network to observe real filtering.
